Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to perform the critical identity verification step between the director of "The Last Horror Movie" and the famous David Winters (the choreographer from West Side Story). The initial search results clearly showed "David Winters" as the director, but the Planner immediately proceeded to search for "David Winters birthplace" without verifying if the David Winters who directed the 2003 film was the same person as the David Winters born in 1939 in London. The search results for "David Winters birthplace" predominantly returned the famous choreographer (born 1939), not the director of the horror film (who is a different person, likely born much later). The Planner accepted the birthplace of the wrong David Winters as the answer, leading to a factual error. The mistake was made in the very first step of the conversation where the Planner decided to engage WebSurfer for the birthplace without first confirming the identity of the director.
